blocks.text: Any license issued under this article may be suspended or revoked for any of the causes set forth in TMC 5.05.100 . The proceedings against the licensee shall be as provided in TMC 5.05.110 and 5.05.120 . (Code 1981 § 46-84. Code 1995 § 154-107.)
